snippet.title: Fallout: Dust - Official Trailer 2
snippet.description:
The second official trailer for Fallout: Dust. The incredibly popular survival expansion/mod for Fallout: New Vegas. 
 
In DUST, your only objective is to escape the Mojave. A lot has changed twenty years after the events of Fallout: New Vegas; a toxic cloud has settled over New Vegas, the world has become infested with Tunnelers, Cannibals, and Survivors not willing to risk their lives by being friendly. Two shots from a pistol can kill you, food is rare, and clean water even more so. You must figure out a way to survive the toxic and dangerous world of Dust. 
 
Will you escape? 
 
Download Dust and find out: http://www.nexusmods.com/newvegas/mods/57927/
 
Directed by: Gage Allen
Original Score by: Arn Andersson
 
Fallout: DUST is the work of Naugrim04. 
 
The commonwealth may find itself in similar turmoil soon...
